objective: Improve visual readability and deliberate menu/navigation interactions for both repository-native example stories while preserving a single externally data-driven Bevy runtime.
note: New, explicitly requested post-MVP polish scope, independent of the previously verified 100/100 runtime roadmap. A feature is counted only after branch CI checks its acceptance criteria.

tasks.description: Keyboard pause overlay with no accidental dialogue or choice advancement
tasks.acceptance: P opens a legible centered pause overlay; Enter/Space while paused cannot advance; P resumes the same visual story frame; Esc quits; automated Linux screenshots and interaction checks pass.
A consistent engine-owned start/continue/quit navigation works on both external games without changing scripts; paused menu navigation offers resume and quit; keyboard paths tested.

tasks.description: Visual hierarchy and adaptive dialogue/choice composition
tasks.acceptance: Speaker, dialogue, choices and hints have clear, consistent spacing and contrast at compact, 16:9 and fullscreen layouts; test screenshots show no panel overflow or clipping.

tasks.description: External themes and both example presentations receive coherent visual styling
tasks.acceptance: Both repository-native examples have intentionally differentiated, readable game data-driven styling and retain theme hot reload; illustrative screenshot evidence is captured and reviewed.
Ending state visibly offers restart, navigation, and exit; no dead-end input; saved and freshly started sessions work and keybindings remain accessible.
All narrative, keyboard, pause, visual, audio decoder, hot reload, save/load, and resize CI passes on main; docs explain repository-native launch and controls.
